title: Capacity planning
description: Hours the team has against the work already scheduled, sold and in the pipeline, for the next 8 weeks.
explain: Each cell is a department's demand as a share of its available hours that week: estimated tasks, remaining package work and weighted pipeline deals.
cellTitle: {demand} of {capacity} hours · tasks {tasks}h · packages {packages}h · pipeline {pipeline}h · new client {simulated}h

simulator.title: Can we take this client?
simulator.body: Pick a package and a start week to see how it would load each department.

verdict.ok: Yes — the team has room for it.
verdict.over: Not without more people or moving work.

simulator.noEffort: This package has no service effort set up yet, so it adds no hours. Set it in Service effort.

warnings.title: Over-allocated people
warnings.none: No one is booked beyond their hours in the next 8 weeks.

timeOff.title: Time off
timeOff.emptyBody: Leave recorded here reduces the capacity for those days.

efforts.body: Hours each department spends on one unit of a package item (for example, one reel = 3h video + 1h content). Package and pipeline demand come from this.

emptyBody: Create departments and add people to them to plan capacity.
